sample injection (SM-FL aspirate and load)
sample pumped through the cell
wash 1 (Loop Offline at its start)
conjugate injection (SM-FL)
conjugate through the cell, two loop volumes, then Loop Offline

front back to the substrate buffer without substrate (B1 -> A2)

conjugate through the bed, two loop volumes, then Loop Offline
wash 2
step to substrate, 215 uL at 80 uL/min
step down to 5 uL/min so that the pump pressure relaxes
accumulation: product collects in the bed
sweep over the electrode and read
